name: Harbour & Hush
tagline: A quiet pocket behind the seafront.
description: Tucked into a lane off Colaba Causeway, Harbour & Hush trades lobby marble for deep sofas and a very good breakfast. Rooms are small but considered, with shutters that keep the city at a polite distance.

name: The Cotton Mill
tagline: Industrial bones, soft landing.
description: A converted mill building with high windows and a rooftop pool that catches the late sun. It is a practical base for south Mumbai, with the train a short walk away.

name: Bandra Bowline
tagline: A courtyard for slow mornings.
description: Bandra Bowline is built around a small courtyard where breakfast runs long. The lanes outside are full of bakeries, record shops, and the occasional film crew.

name: Monsoon Room
tagline: One street back from the sand.
description: A compact studio in a family home, with a kitchenette and a balcony that gets the sea breeze. Juhu beach is a two-minute walk and the city feels far away.

name: Lodhi Courtyard
tagline: Garden views, city access.
description: Low-rise and leafy, with a pool that looks onto the Lodhi gardens. The restaurant leans seasonal and the spa is small enough to feel private.

name: The Brick Lane House
tagline: A base for the south city.
description: Brick Lane House sits between Hauz Khas village and the quieter residential lanes. Rooms are generous, the co-working corner is genuinely useful, and the bar stays low-key.

name: Qila Quiet
tagline: Stone walls, birdsong, and space.
description: A low stone resort on the edge of the Mehrauli archaeological park. The pool is the centrepiece, and the suites open onto private courtyards.

name: Connaught Corner
tagline: Right in the middle of it.
description: A straightforward city hotel a few steps from Rajiv Chowk metro. The rooms are compact, the beds are good, and the location does most of the work.

name: The Salt House
tagline: A short walk from the water.
description: Whitewashed walls, a long pool, and a bar that opens onto the garden. The Salt House is social without being loud, and the beach path is right there.

name: Casa Susegad
tagline: A villa built for a group.
description: A four-bedroom villa with a proper kitchen and a shaded terrace. Assagao's cafes are close, but the pool and the mango tree make it hard to leave.

name: Palolem Pause
tagline: Feet in the sand, simple comforts.
description: Cane-and-timber huts a few steps from Palolem's curve of sand. Expect a fan, a hammock, and the sound of the sea rather than room service.

name: Verdant Verandah
tagline: A slower north Goa.
description: A family home with four guest rooms and a small pool. Breakfast is cooked to order, the verandah catches the morning, and Siolim's river is a short drive.

name: Cubbon Canopy
tagline: Green views in the city centre.
description: A calm, glass-edged hotel beside Cubbon Park. The rooms are quiet, the pool is indoors, and the walk to MG Road is short enough to skip a cab.

name: Indiranagar Ink
tagline: Above the best of 100 Feet Road.
description: A small hotel with a graphic streak, tucked above the cafes and bookshops of Indiranagar. The studios have proper desks and excellent coffee downstairs.

name: The Rain Tree
tagline: An easy, old-Bengaluru stay.
description: A neighbourhood hotel under an actual rain tree, with simple rooms and a breakfast that runs until ten. The market and metro are both close.

name: Whitefield Weave
tagline: Built for the east-side work week.
description: A practical hotel for Whitefield's tech parks, with a rooftop pool and a shuttle that saves the morning commute. Rooms are large and quiet.

name: Fort & Ferry
tagline: Harbour light and high ceilings.
description: A restored merchant house with deep verandahs and a rooftop that faces the harbour. The ferry terminal and the Chinese nets are both a short walk.

name: Backwater Bungalow
tagline: A quiet edge of the backwaters.
description: Low pavilions set among coconut palms, with a pool that meets the water and a kitchen that does a very good fish curry. Come for two nights, stay for three.

name: Spice Route House
tagline: A lane of warehouses and rain.
description: A three-room homestay in a spice trader's old house. The terrace is the best part, especially when the afternoon rain arrives.

name: Marine Drive Muse
tagline: A walk along the water.
description: A modern hotel on Marine Drive with compact, well-lit rooms and a restaurant that opens early. The promenade is directly outside.

name: Lake Loom
tagline: A room with the lake in it.
description: A narrow haveli with a rooftop pool and windows that frame the lake. Breakfast arrives on the terrace, and the old city is on foot.

name: Haveli of Hours
tagline: Carved stone and a slow courtyard.
description: A 19th-century haveli with painted ceilings and a courtyard that stays cool through the afternoon. Some rooms are small; the terrace makes up for it.

name: Aravalli Atrium
tagline: Space, hills, and a longer view.
description: A low resort on the road to the Aravallis, with villas set around a central pool. It is a drive from the lake, but the quiet is the point.

name: The Monsoon Terrace
tagline: A family home above the city.
description: Three rooms on the top floor of a family house, with a shared terrace and a kitchen guests can use. The views open up after the monsoon.

name: Pink City Porch
tagline: A porch made for the evening.
description: A small hotel in a leafy residential lane, with a pool in the courtyard and a porch where everyone ends up after dinner. The old city is a short auto ride.

name: The Block Print
tagline: Pattern, light, and a proper pool.
description: Block-printed textiles, high ceilings, and a pool that gets the afternoon sun. The suites are generous and the spa is worth booking ahead.

name: Amer Courtyard
tagline: Below the fort, above the noise.
description: A courtyard haveli on the road up to Amer Fort. Rooms open onto the central court, and the rooftop looks straight at the hills.

name: The Jaipur Edit
tagline: A clean, central base.
description: A modern budget hotel with compact rooms, a small gym, and a location that puts the city's shops and restaurants within walking distance.

name: Marina Measure
tagline: Across the road from the sand.
description: A straightforward hotel with sea-facing rooms and a restaurant that opens for early breakfast. The beach promenade is directly across the road.

name: Mylapore Morning
tagline: Temple bells and filter coffee.
description: A small hotel in the lanes around Kapaleeshwarar Temple, with a terrace and a breakfast built around filter coffee. The neighbourhood is best explored on foot.

name: The Lattice House
tagline: A quiet, polished city stay.
description: A contemporary hotel with a shaded pool and a strong South Indian restaurant. The suites are large, and the business district is close.

name: Bay of Calm
tagline: The coast road, without the rush.
description: A low resort on the ECR with villas facing the sea and a pool that catches the evening light. It is a drive from the city, which is exactly the idea.
